# Generation-Bound 48-Cell Factorial Benchmark {#sec-factorial-v4}

This chapter reports the completed `factorial_v4` generation: three architecture families crossed with sixteen four-bit objective masks at seed 42. It does not pool the separate 480-job mixed-level U-Net study, whose live protocol and completion gates appear in Chapter 12.

The identifier `family__e?c?m?d?__s42` encodes pointwise MSE (E), correlation loss (C), repaired adaptive multiscale RBF MMD (M), and first-derivative loss (D). Primary confirmatory factorial inference is restricted to the MSE-on (2^3) design. The full MSE toggle is supplementary because a historical MultiScale-VAE decoder-loss defect made eight MSE-off/on checkpoint pairs identical; the quarantine is part of the artifact contract.

::: {.callout-warning}
## Claim status

Core tables are complete and protocol-audited, but the repository-wide final checker remains 9/10 because the independent fresh post-run review was unavailable. Results below are generation-bound empirical estimates, not a claim of clinical equivalence or final external review.
:::

## Artifact, identity, and completeness gate

```{python}
#| label: factorial-v4-gate
#| tbl-cap: "Factorial-v4 identity, completeness, and claim gates."
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import display

ROOT = Path("..").resolve()
R = ROOT / "results/factorial_v4"
RC = ROOT / "results/factorial_v4_clinical"
paths = {
    "master": R / "main_48_cell_table.csv",
    "tests": R / "familywise_endpoint_tests.csv",
    "effects": R / "factorial_effects_bca.csv",
    "effects4": R / "factorial_effects_4factor_supplementary.csv",
    "seeds": R / "supplementary_seed_table.csv",
    "noninferiority": R / "ecgfounder_noninferiority.csv",
    "completeness": R / "completeness.json",
    "protocol": R / "protocol_audit.json",
    "clinical_final": RC / "FINAL_COMPLETION.json",
    "registry": ROOT / "experiment_queue/factorial_v4/model_registry.json",
}
missing = [str(p) for p in paths.values() if not p.is_file()]
if missing:
    raise FileNotFoundError(f"Required factorial-v4 artifacts missing: {missing}")

def sha256_file(path):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as f:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            h.update(chunk)
    return h.hexdigest()

master = pd.read_csv(paths["master"])
tests = pd.read_csv(paths["tests"])
effects = pd.read_csv(paths["effects"])
effects4 = pd.read_csv(paths["effects4"])
seeds = pd.read_csv(paths["seeds"])
noninferiority = pd.read_csv(paths["noninferiority"])
completeness = json.loads(paths["completeness"].read_text())
protocol = json.loads(paths["protocol"].read_text())
clinical_final = json.loads(paths["clinical_final"].read_text())
registry = json.loads(paths["registry"].read_text())
historically_declared = [R / "per_record", R / "echonext_per_record"]
missing_recomputation_roots = [str(p.relative_to(ROOT)) for p in historically_declared if not p.exists()]

master["mask4"] = master.id.str.extract(r"__(e[01]c[01]m[01]d[01])__")[0]
expected_ids = {f"{family}__e{e}c{c}m{m}d{d}__s42" for family in ("unet", "msvae", "ecgaim")
                for e in (0,1) for c in (0,1) for m in (0,1) for d in (0,1)}
assert set(master.id) == expected_ids
assert master.id.is_unique and len(master) == 48
status_counts = master.inference_status.value_counts().to_dict()
assert status_counts == {"valid": 40, "invalid_msvae_mse_toggle_quarantined": 8}
quarantined = master.loc[master.inference_status != "valid"]
assert set(quarantined.family) == {"msvae"}
assert set(quarantined.mask4.str[1]) == {"0"}
assert completeness["status"] == "complete" and all(completeness["checks"].values())
assert protocol["status"] == "pass" and all(protocol["checks"].values())
assert len(tests) == 9 and set(tests.bootstrap_unit) == {"paired_ptbxl_patient_cluster"}

display(pd.DataFrame([
    ("Primary cells", len(master)), ("Families", master.family.nunique()),
    ("Masks per family", master.groupby("family").mask4.nunique().min()),
    ("Exact 3 × 16 identity product", True),
    ("Inferentially valid / quarantined", "40 / 8 (MSVAE MSE-off toggle)"),
    ("Core completeness", completeness["status"]),
    ("Protocol audit", protocol["status"]),
    ("Clinical/final package", f"{clinical_final['status']} ({clinical_final['checks_passed']}/{clinical_final['checks_total']})"),
    ("Current record-level recomputation", "unavailable: " + "; ".join(missing_recomputation_roots) if missing_recomputation_roots else "available"),
    ("Master SHA-256", sha256_file(paths["master"])),
    ("Registry SHA-256", sha256_file(paths["registry"])),
], columns=["Gate", "Observed value"]))
```

The primary test cohort contains 2,198 PTB-XL records from 1,904 patients. Patient-cluster resampling retains repeated records within patient. Global waveform correlation, fixed-window QRS/ST morphology, and frozen-classifier AUROC remain different estimands.

## Complete 48-cell table

```{python}
#| label: factorial-v4-master
#| tbl-cap: "All 48 primary seed-42 cells. Arrows show preferred descriptive direction, not a combined score."
display(master[["id", "family", "mask4", "inference_status", "mse", "r2", "pearson", "qrs_correlation",
                "st_correlation", "ecgfounder_auroc", "morphology_coverage"]]
        .sort_values(["family", "mask4"]))
```

MSE-off cells are retained because they are part of the registered design, but extreme degradation in such cells does not imply that an auxiliary loss is intrinsically harmful; it shows behavior under that complete training configuration. Cross-family differences also change backbone, base objective, and optimizer behavior, so clean loss-component interpretation is within family.

## Fidelity–morphology Pareto surface

```{python}
#| label: factorial-v4-pareto
#| fig-cap: "QRS morphology versus global missing-lead Pearson for all registered cells. Outlined points are nondominated within family for these two higher-is-better endpoints."
import plotly.express as px

def nondominated(group, x, y):
    values = group[[x, y]].to_numpy()
    return np.array([not np.any((values[:,0] >= a) & (values[:,1] >= b) &
                                ((values[:,0] > a) | (values[:,1] > b))) for a,b in values])

valid_master = master.loc[master.inference_status == "valid"].copy()
valid_master["nondominated"] = valid_master.groupby("family", group_keys=False).apply(
    lambda g: pd.Series(nondominated(g, "pearson", "qrs_correlation"), index=g.index),
    include_groups=False,
).sort_index()
fig = px.scatter(valid_master, x="pearson", y="qrs_correlation", color="family", symbol="nondominated",
                 hover_data=["id", "mask4", "inference_status", "mse", "st_correlation", "ecgfounder_auroc"])
fig.update_layout(height=520)
fig.show()
```

This is a two-endpoint descriptive Pareto view, not a universal ranking. Changing either endpoint changes the frontier.

## Prespecified full-composite versus MSE-only contrast

```{python}
#| label: factorial-v4-anchor-deltas
#| tbl-cap: "Aggregate full-composite minus MSE-only differences; inferential patient-level estimands are shown separately below."
anchors = master.loc[master.mask4.isin(["e1c0m0d0", "e1c1m1d1"])].copy()
assert len(anchors) == 6
wide = anchors.set_index(["family", "mask4"])
rows = []
for family in ("unet", "msvae", "ecgaim"):
    base, full = wide.loc[(family, "e1c0m0d0")], wide.loc[(family, "e1c1m1d1")]
    row = {"family": family}
    for metric in ["mse", "pearson", "qrs_correlation", "st_correlation", "ecgfounder_auroc"]:
        row[f"delta_{metric}"] = full[metric] - base[metric]
    rows.append(row)
display(pd.DataFrame(rows))
```

Aggregate correlation differences are not numerically interchangeable with means of patient-level paired differences. The next table is the prespecified inferential authority.

```{python}
#| label: factorial-v4-familywise-tests
#| tbl-cap: "Prespecified full-minus-MSE-only patient-cluster BCa tests. Multiplicity is controlled over three endpoints within each architecture."
display(tests[["family", "endpoint", "estimate", "ci_low", "ci_high", "p_value", "alpha",
               "reject_null", "n", "n_patients", "n_resamples", "bootstrap_unit"]])
```

The QRS and ST endpoints are reference-R-peak-anchored fixed windows, not clinical delineation. Their coverage is detector coverage, and the protocol does not turn unmatched reconstructed events into false positives. LUDB/RDB event matching answers a different question.

## MSE-on factorial effects

```{python}
#| label: factorial-v4-effects
#| tbl-cap: "Patient-cluster BCa main and pairwise effects in the prespecified MSE-on 2³ design."
primary_effects = effects.loc[
    effects.effect_type.isin(["main", "pairwise"]),
    ["family", "metric", "effect", "effect_type", "estimate", "ci_low", "ci_high",
     "n_patients", "n_resamples", "protocol"]
].copy()
display(primary_effects)
```

Effect signs must be interpreted by metric: lower MSE is favorable, whereas higher correlation is favorable. Interactions prevent reducing the design to one context-free “importance” score.

```{python}
#| label: factorial-v4-effect-forest
#| fig-cap: "Selected MSE-on main effects with patient-cluster BCa intervals. Metrics are faceted because scales and directions differ."
plot_effects = primary_effects.loc[primary_effects.effect_type == "main"].copy()
fig = px.scatter(plot_effects, x="estimate", y="effect", color="family", facet_col="metric",
                 error_x=plot_effects.ci_high-plot_effects.estimate,
                 error_x_minus=plot_effects.estimate-plot_effects.ci_low)
fig.add_vline(x=0, line_dash="dash", line_color="gray")
fig.update_xaxes(matches=None)
fig.update_layout(height=620)
fig.show()
```

## Frozen-classifier non-inferiority analysis

```{python}
#| label: factorial-v4-noninferiority
#| tbl-cap: "Registered ECGFounder non-inferiority results under the repository's 0.02 AUROC margin."
valid_ids = set(master.loc[master.inference_status == "valid", "id"])
ni = noninferiority.loc[noninferiority.id.isin(valid_ids)].copy()
ni_summary = ni.groupby("family", as_index=False).agg(
    cells=("id", "size"), noninferior_cells=("noninferior", "sum"),
    worst_ci_low=("ci_low", "min"), median_difference=("difference", "median"),
    patients=("n_patients", "first"), resamples=("n_resamples", "first"),
)
display(ni_summary)
```

Passing this registered margin is evidence about one frozen classifier and margin, not proof of diagnostic equivalence. The rationale and clinical acceptability of the margin remain separate questions.

## Supplementary optimization seeds

```{python}
#| label: factorial-v4-seeds
#| tbl-cap: "Validation behavior for selected base, full, and interim-best configurations at seeds 1337 and 2026."
seed_summary = seeds.groupby(["family", "slot", "mask"], as_index=False).agg(
    seeds=("seed", lambda s: ",".join(map(str, sorted(s)))),
    validation_mse_min=("validation_mse", "min"), validation_mse_max=("validation_mse", "max"),
    validation_pearson_min=("validation_pearson", "min"), validation_pearson_max=("validation_pearson", "max"),
)
seed_summary["pearson_range"] = seed_summary.validation_pearson_max-seed_summary.validation_pearson_min
display(seed_summary)
```

These selected validation replications do not convert the complete seed-42 grid into a multiseed test study. Patient-cluster uncertainty and optimization-seed uncertainty are distinct.

## Quarantined supplementary MSE toggle

The 4-factor supplementary file remains available for forensics, but the MultiScale-VAE MSE toggle is excluded from claims because paired checkpoints were tensor-identical under the historical detached decoder-loss path. The prespecified MSE-on (2^3) effects and familywise full-versus-MSE-only endpoint tests are reported only according to the locked claim-scope rules. Rendering never rewrites the release report.

## Interpretation boundary

The defensible result is architecture- and endpoint-specific: auxiliary shape/distribution terms can change QRS/ST preservation and waveform fidelity, while frozen-classifier AUROC need not move in the same direction. No cell wins every endpoint, and post hoc maxima are exploratory. Current authority resides in `results/factorial_v4/` plus the generation registry and protocol audit; the removed `comprehensive_latest_48_models` path is not used.
